title: The Review of the Whole Day
youtube_title: The Review of the Whole Day | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: A story belongs to the person still speaking it.
summary: At a library window seat, the ferryman begins to tell Remy about review of a day that was not done until the evening part. Remy wants to interrupt with bigger news, but listens all the way to the last sentence, asks one real question, and only then shares something small of their own.
